videos.title: How I make UI color palettes
videos.why: A five-step method from one starting colour to a full UI palette; the shades step at 4:18 is the same tint and shade scale lab-palette generates, and the neutrals step at 6:07 is the part people skip.

videos.title: The Easy Way to Pick UI Colors
videos.why: Sajid argues colour is the easiest part of UI once you have a simple method, and shows his; compare it step by step with the UX Tools method and keep whichever you will actually use.

podcasts.why: A long conversation about colour in product interfaces with guest Lukas Oppermann; listen for the habits working designers use when one palette has to cover a whole product.

podcasts.episode: Dark Theme with KAYAK: How Dark Mode Revolutionized a Brand's Approach to Color (2020 Material Design Awards)
podcasts.why: How building a dark theme forced the KAYAK team to rethink their whole colour system; a real case for defining colours by role instead of by hex value.

reads.title: Building Your Color Palette
reads.why: Why five hex codes are not a palette, and why you need 8 to 10 shades of grey plus a range for each primary and accent colour; the clearest short case for tint and shade scales.

reads.title: Designing accessible color systems
reads.why: How Stripe rebuilt its palette with a perceptual colour model because HSL lightness is misleading across hues; explains why a blue and a yellow at the 'same' lightness can fail contrast differently.

reads.title: Color roles
reads.why: Google's 26 colour roles (primary, surface, outline, the 'on' colours for text on top of fills, and so on); the same role-based thinking you practise in lab-tokens.
